text:
### To You (Staff Member)  
**Criminal Liability:**
- Money laundering facilitation: Up to 14 years prison
- Fraud: Up to 10 years prison
- Data protection breach: Up to 2 years prison
- Tipping-off (warning customer of screening): Criminal offense  
**Professional Consequences:**
- Dismissal from FirstUK Bank
- Industry ban (you can't work in banking)
- Professional certification revoked
- Difficulty finding employment  
**Financial Consequences:**
- Criminal fines
- Civil penalties
- Compensation to victims
- Legal costs

raw_entities.name: Module on Criminal Liability and Professional Consequences for Staff
raw_entities.description: A training module addressing the criminal, professional, and financial consequences that staff members face for money laundering facilitation, fraud, data protection breaches, and tipping-off. The module outlines prison sentences, dismissal, industry bans, and financial penalties to reinforce compliance obligations.
context: Money laundering facilitation: Up to 14 years prison
Tipping-off (warning customer of screening): Criminal offense
Industry ban (you can't work in banking)

raw_entities.name: Understanding Criminal Liability for Money Laundering Facilitation
raw_entities.description: Staff must understand that facilitating money laundering carries a criminal penalty of up to 14 years imprisonment, establishing the severity of this compliance obligation.
context: Money laundering facilitation: Up to 14 years prison

raw_entities.name: Understanding Criminal Liability for Fraud
raw_entities.description: Staff must understand that committing or facilitating fraud carries a criminal penalty of up to 10 years imprisonment.

raw_entities.name: Understanding Criminal Liability for Data Protection Breach
raw_entities.description: Staff must understand that data protection breaches carry a criminal penalty of up to 2 years imprisonment.
context: Data protection breach: Up to 2 years prison

raw_entities.name: Understanding the Prohibition on Tipping-Off
raw_entities.description: Staff must understand that warning a customer of AML screening or suspicious activity reporting is a criminal offense and is strictly prohibited.
context: Tipping-off (warning customer of screening): Criminal offense

raw_entities.name: Understanding Professional Consequences of Non-Compliance
raw_entities.description: Staff must understand the professional consequences of compliance failures, including dismissal from FirstUK Bank, industry bans, revocation of professional certification, and employment difficulties.
context: Industry ban (you can't work in banking)

raw_entities.name: Understanding Financial Consequences of Non-Compliance
raw_entities.description: Staff must understand the financial consequences of compliance failures, including criminal fines, civil penalties, compensation to victims, and legal costs.

raw_entities.name: Prohibition on Tipping-Off Customers of AML Screening
raw_entities.description: Staff must not warn or inform customers that they are subject to AML screening, sanctions checks, or suspicious activity reporting. Tipping-off is a criminal offense under AML legislation.
context: Tipping-off (warning customer of screening): Criminal offense

raw_entities.name: Obligation to Comply with Money Laundering Prevention
raw_entities.description: Staff must actively prevent and not facilitate money laundering. Failure to comply carries criminal liability of up to 14 years imprisonment.
context: Money laundering facilitation: Up to 14 years prison

raw_entities.name: Obligation to Comply with Fraud Prevention
raw_entities.description: Staff must not commit or facilitate fraud. Failure to comply carries criminal liability of up to 10 years imprisonment.

raw_entities.name: Obligation to Protect Customer Data
raw_entities.description: Staff must protect customer data and comply with data protection regulations. Breaches carry criminal liability of up to 2 years imprisonment.
context: Data protection breach: Up to 2 years prison

raw_entities.name: Staff Member
raw_entities.description: The staff member or employee of FirstUK Bank who is the subject of this consequences training. The module addresses the criminal, professional, and financial liabilities that apply to staff who fail to comply with AML, fraud prevention, and data protection obligations.
context: Industry ban (you can't work in banking)
